patches.name: Watch history on your server
patches.description: Keeps the watch history and resume positions on your own server instead of Google's, so YouTube's history can stay off. Requires Morphe official patches and a yt-history server.

options.description: Base URL of the history API of your yt-history server.
Sent to the server in the X-Token header. Leave empty to use YT_HISTORY_TOKEN from the environment or from ~/.config/env/yt-history on the computer that patches.
